title: Nutty Garlicky Thai Oats Kanom Ko
description: A garlicky, chewy, and adventurous Thai dish featuring oats, cooked to perfection in a fondue pot, perfect for a unique snack or dessert. This vegetarian-friendly recipe combines the warmth of Thai cuisine with the comfort of oats.

ingredients.name: Rolled oats
ingredients.notes: Old-fashioned or quick-cooking oats work well

instructions: In a fondue pot or a large heatproof bowl set over a pot of simmering water, combine the oats and water.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cook, stirring frequently, until the oats have absorbed most of the water and the mixture is creamy and thick.
In a small skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and cook the minced garlic and grated ginger until fragrant.
Add the cooked garlic and ginger to the oat mixture and stir to combine.
Add the Thai red curry paste, chopped peanuts, salt, and sugar to the oat mixture and stir until well combined.
Continue cooking the mixture, stirring frequently, until it has reached a thick and chewy consistency.
Remove the fondue pot or bowl from the heat and let the mixture cool slightly.
Using a spoon or small ice cream scoop, shape the mixture into small kanom ko shapes and serve warm.
